message:
An ESP Migration Agent pipeline stage failed (discovery, propose, execute, or reconcile — the stage is in the monitor tags). The run's own stderr has the named error; these are laptop CLI runs, so check the terminal that ran it and the LLM Obs trace under ml_app:esp-migration-agent for the propose/discovery stages.

Counts come from esp_migration.pipeline_run (telemetry/metrics.py, ADR-0008): telemetry never fails a run, so a failure here is the pipeline itself.

RC1-548. @webhook-incident-summarizer
name: ESP migration — pipeline run failed
